title: 'Death by restriction': As Trump sours H-1B visa dream, who faces biggest hit?
content: Three H-1B related changes are stacking on top of each other: the multiple $100,000 fee proposals, the wage-weighted lottery favoring more senior workers, new layoff and compliance scrutiny, and now the OPT/STEM-OPT $70,000 fee proposal for students looking to work in the US. The pathway is set to become much narrower or worse may even disappear!

title: 'Dhappa' gets Day 3 twist as cops allow Rahul, INDIA bloc MPs to protest at Raj Ghat
content: Opposition leaders, after previously being stopped by police, successfully reached Raj Ghat for their protest. They staged a brief sit-in to honor Mahatma Gandhi while voicing their concerns about electoral integrity. Congress leaders accused the government and Election Commission of undermining democratic rights and engaging in a conspiracy. Rahul Gandhi emphasized the need for justice regarding these electoral issues.

title: Munir overrules Pak PM, to deploy more military assets to Riyadh under Mecca pact
content: Pakistan's defence forces chief Asim Munir has confirmed plans to deploy additional troops to Saudi Arabia. This deployment comes despite the country's parliament deciding against involvement in the Houthi conflict previously. The decision follows a recently signed Mecca defence pact between Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey. Furthermore, Munir's increasing power and influence within the Pakistani political landscape are noteworthy.

title: How IAF's first Hawai Sepoys came into being: Their story dates back to 1932
content: Before the Indian Air Force took its first flight in 1933, a lesser-known chapter of its history was already taking shape. The story of the Hawai Sepoys goes back to the early years of the force, when finding and training skilled personnel was among its first challenges. Their journey offers a glimpse into how the IAF's foundations were laid.

title: Gabe Newell says 3 months under Bill Gates taught him more than his time at Harvard
content: Gabe Newell, the visionary co-founder of Valve, has constructed an impressive megayacht named Leviathan, which pays tribute to almost 3,000 contributors involved in its development. This floating masterpiece includes a communal sea lobby dedicated to architects, craftspeople, contractors, and crew members, while offering leisure areas and cutting-edge facilities suited for ocean exploration and neuroscience research.

title: Air India, AI Express hike fuel surcharge amid rising costs; Akasa Air reinstates levy
content: India's airlines are set to implement higher fuel surcharges for both domestic and international routes, starting October 9. Air India and Air India Express will adjust their fees in light of escalating global oil prices. Meanwhile, Akasa Air is reintroducing surcharges on its domestic flights, which will now range from Rs 375 to Rs 1,150, depending on flight distance. Increased surcharges will also apply to international flights, varying by destination.

title: From France to Italy, Belgium to Greece, student protests spread across Europe
content: The movement began in the Paris region in mid-September, when high-school students and teachers protested over a lack of resources and staff. It quickly spread across France, with students blocking school entrances and later joined by university students, parents and trade unions. Their complaints include overcrowded classrooms, teachers not being replaced when absent, long school hours, deteriorating buildings and inequalities between schools in wealthier and poorer areas.

title: Jon Stewart and wife turned 45-acre New Jersey farm into animal sanctuary
content: In 2016, Jon Stewart and Tracey Stewart acquired Hockhockson Farm in Colts Neck, New Jersey, with the vision of establishing both a working farm and a sanctuary for rescued farm animals. Their ambitious plans include educational programs focused on sustainable farming and healthy eating. The property is equipped with barns and pastures, as well as facilities dedicated to animal care, successfully fulfilling its mission of promoting agriculture and welfare.

title: Serena Williams helped build Jamaica school giving free education to 80 kids
content: Serena Williams has taken an admirable step towards education by contributing to the Salt Marsh Basic School in Trelawny, Jamaica. This school provides free preschool education to local children, significantly improving their access to learning. By physically participating in the building process alongside other volunteers, Williams showcased the value of community collaboration in fostering educational growth and ensuring a safe space for the children.

title: Nebraska wind turbine lease pays up to $12,500 a year for about 1 acre
content: A Nebraska farmer leases a 160-acre parcel for a wind turbine that occupies just one acre, leaving the remaining land available for farming. According to a 2021 NRECA case study, developer Bluestem Energy Solutions says a typical 30-year lease averages $10,000 to $12,500 annually, compared with an estimated $600 from growing corn on the same acre.

title: JP Morgan CEO has a 'suggestion' for companies building datacenters in America
content: Jamie Dimon has highlighted the need for data centre developers to select states that are supportive of AI infrastructure initiatives. He emphasized the necessity for adequate electricity capacity in these locations. Dimon also pointed out the escalating cybersecurity threats linked to sophisticated AI models, such as Anthropic's Mythos. It is essential for companies to manage these emerging vulnerabilities proactively instead of reacting in panic.

title: Palm Beach couple bought waterfront home for $9m, later sold it for $25.4m
content: Cornelia and Richard Thornburgh have successfully sold their prestigious lakefront mansion on Everglades Island for an impressive $25.4 million. Initially priced at $24.9 million, the property saw multiple price adjustments before finding a buyer. Acquired by the couple in 2014 for $9 million, they invested significantly in renovations. Following this lucrative sale, they opted for a cozy historic bungalow on Australian Avenue, purchased for $8.12 million.

title: GST Council scraps tax officers' arrest powers; prosecution threshold raised to Rs 5 cr
content: The GST Council made a landmark decision by abolishing the arrest powers of tax officers. They've raised the prosecution threshold from Rs 1 crore to Rs 5 crore, easing the pressure on small sellers using e-commerce platforms. Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced that notices under Rs 10,000 will no longer be issued, aimed at promoting better GST compliance and alleviating burdens on small businesses.

title: India's GDP is booming, but stock market is crashing: What's going on?
content: India is experiencing impressive GDP growth of 7.8%, while the World Bank revises its growth outlook to 7.1%. Yet, Dalal Street faces turbulence as benchmark indices suffer losses exceeding 1%. This is largely due to foreign investors offloading shares and rising bond yields globally, fostering a cautious sentiment in the market.

title: Travis Kelce’s mom Donna Kelce helps raise $4,100 for students’ lunch debt
content: Travis Kelce’s mom Donna Kelce helped turn her famous family cookie recipe into a charity fundraiser for Kansas schoolchildren. After small-business owner Annie Stowe received permission to print the recipe on handmade mugs, $5 from each sale went towards paying elementary school lunch debt. The mugs initially raised $2,000 in 2023, followed by another $2,100 after local coverage, bringing the total to $4,100.

title: Patrick Mahomes’ personal life: What changed as he focuses on Week 5?
content: Patrick Mahomes, the Kansas City Chiefs’ popular quarterback's father receives permision to watch his games.

title: John Paul DeJoria turned 96-acre Texas ranch into home for 120 exotic animals
content: In a remarkable real estate deal, the sprawling Texas ranch of Patrón Tequila co-founder John Paul DeJoria has been acquired for $6.93 million. Spanning 96 acres, this unique property was home to over 120 exotic African animals, including gazelles and wildebeest. Complete with a luxurious main residence and an underground shelter, the estate also boasted a well-stocked pond.

title: Sandra Bullock’s 91-acre California ranch with 1,200 avocado trees sells for $5.6M
content: In 2007, Sandra Bullock acquired a sprawling 91-acre ranch in Valley Center for $2.725 million. After transforming it with extensive renovations and establishing an organic avocado farm, she sold the property for $5.6 million in 2024. Encompassing a beautifully refurbished adobe house, a guest cottage, and facilities for agricultural operations, the ranch stands as a perfect blend of luxury and sustainability for its future owner.

title: Jason and Kylie Kelce's $553,500 charity effort helps kids through Be Philly
content: Jason and Kylie Kelce proudly hosted their third annual Underdog Golf Outing, raising an impressive $553,500 for their Be Philly Foundation, dedicated to supporting underserved children in Philadelphia. This successful event saw 96 participants, including several notable former athletes, effectively blending sports and charitable efforts. Looking ahead, Be Philly aims to amplify its influence, targeting the distribution of over $1 million in 2026 to empower the youth of Philadelphia.

title: Dr Phil’s Beverly Hills mansion bought for $29.8m now lists for $67.5m
content: Dr. Phil and his wife Robin McGraw are parting ways with their opulent Beverly Hills estate, listed for a staggering $67.5 million. Acquired for $29.8 million in 2010, the couple undertook extensive renovations, culminating in a dream home featuring eight luxurious bedrooms, a swimming pool, and a guesthouse. This significant increase in value mirrors the thriving real estate market trends in the prestigious Beverly Hills neighborhood.

title: Nana Patekar last rites: Mortal remains to reach Pune, state funeral likely by 10pm
content: Nana Patekar passed away on October 8 in Goa and his final rites will take place in Pune. His mortal remains are expected to arrive at Pune airport later in the evening. Authorities are preparing for increased traffic congestion due to VIP movement and mourners gathering at the farmhouse in Donaje. The traffic plan aims to ensure smooth movement for both the funeral procession and regular commuters.

title: Six hours a day, 19% to 14% body fat: Inside Bhuvneshwar's bid for longevity
content: At 36, Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back in India’s T20I setup, four years after his last international appearance. His recall followed a 28-wicket IPL season for RCB and a strong UP T20 campaign, but the numbers tell only part of the story. His strength and conditioning coach reveals how Bhuvneshwar cut his body fat from 19% to 14%, spent up to seven hours a day training and rebuilt his fitness to force his way back.

title: Australia buys 74,000-hectare station to protect pink lakes, threatened species
content: The acquisition of Pulgamurtie Station in New South Wales, covering 74,000 hectares of unique landscapes, aims to protect the area's stunning pink lakes and vulnerable wildlife. This initiative not only prioritizes Aboriginal cultural heritage but also fosters diverse ecosystems vital for local species. Future plans include opportunities for recreational activities like birdwatching and scenic drives, supporting Australia's goal to expand protected areas.

title: Sumeet Raghavan calls out tourists for littering during Himachal trip
content: Sumeet Raghavan took a trip to the picturesque Tattapani hot springs with a team from Indus Paragliding School. While enjoying the natural beauty, they made a positive impact by picking up litter along the trail. Sharing their efforts on Instagram, Raghavan voiced his concerns over the increasing pollution and urged the Himachal Pradesh government to enforce stricter cleanliness measures.

title: DoorDash driver crashes during delivery; fundraiser later tops $15,000
content: A DoorDash driver in Maryland, US, survived a serious crash after his car's brakes failed during a delivery. Despite the accident, he told his customer where to collect the food. The customer's video of the unusual pickup went viral, drawing attention to the driver's financial difficulties. An online fundraiser later raised over $16,000 to help him recover.

title: Why high-IQ people may spend longer analysing emotional pain, psychology says
content: Research indicates that higher verbal intelligence can result in greater rumination and worry after experiencing negative emotions. While intelligent individuals may analyze their feelings in multiple dimensions, this can sometimes lead to excessive repetitive thinking. Reflection can lead to understanding, but when it evolves into rumination, it may create confusion. Moreover, cognitive processing does not guarantee emotional regulation, creating challenges in dealing with emotions.

title: 17-year-old rents Audi crashes into 3 vehicles in Delhi, kills pedestrian
content: A 17-year-old rented an Audi for a friend's birthday celebration and caused a serious accident. The incident occurred around 2.30am on October 4 in Kishangarh. The driver allegedly crashed into three vehicles, resulting in the death of a pedestrian. Police apprehended the juvenile and registered an FIR related to his reckless driving. Investigators are also looking into the rental company's processes for verifying the driver's age and documents.

title: Sports ministry, federations to review Asian Games performance on October 13
content: On October 13, officials from the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports will evaluate India's performance at the Asian Games. The nation secured far fewer medals than in previous tournaments, prompting a detailed review of financial allocations and the performance of seasoned athletes who fell short of expectations. Additionally, the existence of injuries before the Games has raised questions about the overall fairness of the competing teams.

title: Delhi Police crime branch to probe July 20 CJP protest violence; FIR registered
content: On July 20, the protesters, gathered on the appeal of the CJP, were marching towards Parliament when the situation turned tensed as demonstrators attempted to move towards Parliament and breach police barricades in central Delhi, security personnel used tear gas and lathi-charge to disperse the protesters. Several videos subsequently circulated on social media, purportedly showing protesters being manhandled by police personnel, leading to allegations of excessive use of force.

title: 'Campaign driven by political interests': 42 ex-judges back CEC in open letter
content: Veterans said that "criticism of institutions is a democratic right. Denigration is not". They also hit out at the Congress party, which has double-down its verbal assault on Gyanesh Kumar, by questioning how the party's victory through the same EVM goes unquestioned. The ex-service members also highlighted how ECI's demand for sworn declaration was not submitted by the Lok Sabha leader of opposition Rahul Gandhi.

title: UN-doing the United Nations: Can its next chief fix a system under strain?
content: Created in 1945 after two devastating world wars, the United Nations was designed to prevent another global catastrophe, provide a forum where countries could resolve disputes and give weaker countries a voice in an international system. The global platform once strongly voiced in the support of decolonisation, delivered humanitarian assistance, facilitated peace operations and provided a platform where even the smallest countries can speak is under immense strain.

title: TCS Q2 results: Net profit rises 15% to Rs 13,884 crore, revenue up 11%
content: Tata Consultancy Services has reported a notable 15% surge in net profit for the September quarter, achieving Rs 13,884 crore. The operations revenue grew by 11.22% year-on-year, hitting Rs 73,188 crore. AI revenue also surpassed $3 billion, contributing over 10% to the total income. With 4,258 new hires, TCS's workforce now stands at 5,98,056 and an attrition rate of 13.3%.

title: Stanford blood cancer transplant therapy reaches first commercial patient
content: In a remarkable advancement, Stanford researchers have unveiled Orca-T therapy, which has recently received FDA approval. After two decades of rigorous development, this innovative treatment was administered to its inaugural commercial patient, a high-risk leukemia sufferer. Notably, Orca-T significantly minimizes the chances of graft-versus-host disease post-stem cell transplants, offering reduced chemotherapy requirements and lower side effects. Future studies are anticipated to investigate its relevance for broader patient demographics.

title: Air India Delhi-Riyadh flight makes U-turn after Houthi attack on Saudi airport
content: air India and Air India Express suspend operations to and from Riyadh until 2026 . flight AI2243 had departed from Delhi and was flying south, over Gujarat, before proceeding over the Arabian Sea . the pilots subsequently turned the aircraft around and are currently flying back towards Delhi .

title: Prince William’s foundation funds Cornwall homes for 16 people facing homelessness
content: the development in Nansledan, newquay, combines carefully designed homes with practical support . it will provide accommodation for 16 people across two four-bedroom homes and eight one-bedroom apartments . the development was designed around more than simply providing a roof .
